news.title: Amputee football: Morocco come from behind to beat Brazil and reach World Cup final
news.lede: Morocco's amputee football team are continuing their exceptional run at the 2026 World Cup. After falling behind, the Atlas Lions fought back to beat Brazil 2-1 on Friday in the semi-finals in Mexico and book their place in the final. A victory full of character that moves them closer to a first world title. Rieltony LOUBOKO · Author profile · 21/11/2026 08:22 UTC.

news.title: Ghana’s national amputee team stun defending champions Türkiye to reach historic football World Cup final
news.lede: Ghana’s Black Challenge have booked a historic first-ever place in the final of the 2026 WAFF Amputee Football World Cup after defeating defending champions Türkiye 4-3 on penalties following a 1-1 draw after extra time in their semi-final in Mexico, after overcoming an early group-stage setback and successive knockout challenges. Ghana and Türkiye were goalless in regulation time before tournament-leading scorer Mohammed Mubarik converted a penalty nine minutes into extra time, after his effort in the box was handled. It was his seventh goal of the competition and his fifth consecutive match on the scoresheet. Disaster however struck Ghana after hardworking midfielder Hamza Mohammed received a red card moments after the Black Challenge scored, handing the opponents a vital numerical advantage.

news.title: 2026 Amputee World Cup: Ghana dump holders, Türkiye out to make history
news.lede: PAY ATTENTION: Mark YEN.com.gh as a preferred source, and our content will appear higher in your Google feed! Ghana's Black Challenge have made history at the 2026 Amputee World Cup, eliminating defending champions Türkiye in the semi-finals to secure a place in the tournament's final. The victory was sealed on penalties, with Ghana winning the shootout 4-3 after the two sides could not be separated in extra-time. Against the defending champions, the first 50 minutes produced no goals before Mubarik converted a penalty in the opening period of extra-time to give Ghana the lead.

news.title: Black Stars 2026 World Cup campaign cost US$4.67m of US$5m advance, Adams tells Parliament
news.lede: The minister put the exact spend at US$4,673,337.46, with players receiving US$100,000 each in appearance fees, and a balance of US$326,662.54 left. The Black Stars' 2026 World Cup campaign cost US$4.67 million of the US$5 million government advance, Sports and Recreation Minister Kofi Adams has told Parliament. Answering questions on the floor on Friday, Adams put the exact spend at US$4,673,337.46, leaving an unspent balance of US$326,662.54. Parliament streamed the sitting on its own channel.

news.title: FIFA World Cup: Andile Dlamini withdrawn from Banyana squad due to injury
news.lede: Banyana Banyana goalkeeper Andile Dlamini has been withdrawn from the squad that is travelling to Morocco for the FIFA World Cup Inter-Continental Play-offs in the coming days due to injury. The Mamelodi Sundowns Ladies shot stopper suffered the setback during the final of the CAF Women’s Champions League in Egypt this past weekend. She will miss the play-offs, and her place will be taken by the University of the Western Cape (UWC) goalkeeper Thandeka Ngcobo, who will work alongside Kaylin Swart and Kebotseng Moletsane in the goalkeeping department. Banyana Banyana assembled for camp on Tuesday night and will depart for North Africa on Thursday evening.

news.title: 2026 Amputee World Cup: Ghana beat Türkiye on penalties to reach final against Morocco
news.lede: Ghana's national amputee football team, the Black Challenge, have booked their place in the final of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico after defeating Türkiye 4-3 on penalties in a dramatic semifinal encounter. The game ended 1-1 after extra time, with both sides finishing with a player fewer following red cards. After a goalless 50 minutes of regulation time, Ghana broke the deadlock in the first half of extra time when Mubarik Mohammed converted from the penalty spot to put the Black Challenge ahead. However, Türkiye fought back in the second half of extra time to restore parity and force the game into a penalty shootout.
